selected: reuse the existing task index with direct scans and size-aware capacity
method: Library timings count 1,000 model constructions per sample, with three process pairs and nine retained samples per process. Endpoint probe counters span 12,000 builds per process, including warmups. Probe times include instrumentation overhead. CLI samples launch separate Node processes and include startup through serialization. Peak RSS is process-lifetime high water. Candidate driver is first in reverse runs.
